messages:
Theo (CSM): FYI BlueLattice is up for renewal. Procurement wants NET60 on the PO and a 60/40 split (PO/CC). They also want a short services appendix that lists SSO + 1 integration as acceptance. Can we accept without changing price?
Rina (AE): They're requesting same pricing, 12->12 renewal. ARR = $120k. If Finance needs lower exposure we can propose 50/50 or keep 60/40 if CC is captured at signature.
Vikram (BlueLattice): Procurement mandates NET60 for POs, their auditors require a purchase order trail. They can do 40% CC upfront. Prefer PO-first.
Alex (Billing): NET60 >50% PO needs Finance approval. Need vendor code, remit-to, tax ID, and PO sample. For split-pay flow: capture 40% CC -> invoice remaining 60% with `PO: BL-2026-330` NET60.
Procurement Bot: Note: "NET60 with >50% on PO requires Finance + Legal approval and a signed services appendix. Vendor code must appear on invoice."
Theo (CSM): @Finance can you confirm exposure acceptability and if 40% upfront is sufficient? Also tagging Legal Ops for appendix language that ties acceptance to SSO test and integration checklist.
Finance: For ARR at $120k, 40% upfront is borderline but acceptable with FP&A signoff. Please provide revenue schedule and CC auth screenshot for final sign-off.
Legal Ops: We'll prepare a one-page services appendix listing SSO completion and one integration endpoint as acceptance criteria. Signature: DocuSign amendment preferred; PO referencing Master Agreement also OK if it includes our vendor code and Finance approval email on thread.
Vikram (BlueLattice): We can reference the Master Agreement in the PO. DocuSign is doable but procurement prefers PO. I'll try to get PO to reference "Master Agreement v3" and include vendor code.
Alex (Billing): Example invoice header we need on PO: `VendorCode: RWINF-14\nTaxID: 33-4445556\nPO: BL-2026-330`. I'll prep invoice template and CC payment link.
Onboarding Eng: Note: we require the 40% CC to clear before scheduling integration work. We can start docs/tasks as soon as PO or DocuSign is received.
Rina (AE): Action items: (1) Vikram to send PO draft + vendor code (2) Theo to collect CC auth screenshot when payment attempts (3) Legal Ops to draft appendix (4) Alex to prepare invoice template & payment link (5) Finance to provide FP&A sign-off once revenue schedule posted.
Vikram (BlueLattice): VendorCode=BL-VC-90. PO draft ETA tomorrow. Procurement asked that the invoice show vendor code and PO on the first page.
Theo (CSM): Thanks all. Please react with :thumbsup: when your item is done. I'll update once PO or DocuSign + CC auth screenshot arrives.
